title: "Goal state not set, assuming aborted" and rclpy action goals that won't cancel: default REJECT, blocked executors, measured
excerpt: Why rclpy action goals ignore cancel requests: the default cancel callback rejects, a single-threaded server answers 4 s late with return code 3, and loops that skip is_cancel_requested. Plus what triggers Goal state not set and invalid transition errors, on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
